glyph.isekai_mahou.meteor.desc: A rift opens in the sky and a blazing rock crashes onto the aimed point: area effects, shockwave and a crater. Amplify = bigger rock; Split = more rocks.
glyph.isekai_mahou.meteor_shower.desc: Ultimate: the sky darkens and bleeds; for 15 s, 10 + 4×Circle meteors fall on the aimed area, each with the effects and its own crater. Can be countered while it lasts.
glyph.isekai_mahou.transcend.desc: Ultimate: awaken for 30 s with a halo and wings of light: flight, +50% power, ×3 mana regeneration, halved cooldowns and the effects pulsing on enemies within 6 blocks. Then, Magic Exhaustion.
glyph.isekai_mahou.colossus.desc: Ultimate: summons a 12-block spectral giant in the element's color for 30 s. It follows you, cuts in wide arcs, stomps the ground applying the effects and blocks projectiles coming from the front.
effect.isekai_mahou.transcendence.descri: Flight, +50% spell power, ×3 mana and halved cooldowns. When it ends, Magic Exhaustion.
